Premium DM Ratio

Perbandingan Damage (Condition = DM) dengan dan tanpa Total Loss. Total Loss dikenali saat kolom Total Loss bernilai Checked.
Premium Only
DM Ratio With TTL
0.0%
0 DM / 0 total stock
DM Ratio Without TTL
0.0%
0 non-TTL DM / 0 total stock
Total Loss (TTL)
0
0.0% dari total Premium
DM Excluding TTL
0
0 DM setelah TTL dikeluarkan
Formula: With TTL = seluruh Condition DM ÷ Total Premium Stock. Without TTL = DM non-TTL ÷ Total Premium Stock. Total Loss dikeluarkan dari jumlah DM, sementara denominator tetap total stock agar perbandingan with vs without TTL setara.
